mentions.name: batchscan
mentions.description: This workflow processes a personal photo collection, generating a text description, a list of keywords, and the mood for each photo by feeding images through Gemini. A planned next step is face detection so the most recurring faces can be labeled and all images tagged accordingly. It currently runs on the author's machine, taking 30+ seconds per image, and is shared as a git repo; the author describes it as a personal project at this point.
mentions.source_excerpt: I doubt it's useful to anyone but myself at this point, but it does work on my machine (taking 30+ sec per image). here's the git repo https://github.com/gdoct/batchscan
